name: prompt_enhancer
summary: Deterministic spell-fix + structural prompt enhancement. No LLM calls. Levenshtein against a known-keyword index for spell fixes; rule-based injection of SCOPE / INTENT / CONSTRAINTS / OUTPUT markers; the OUTPUT marker also instructs controlled models to emit a <forward>...</forward> tail.
engine_pattern: stateless. enhance(text, scope_hint) → {original, enhanced, replacements, added_markers, scope_hint}.
pipeline: 1. Normalize whitespace + line endings (\r\n → \n; trailing whitespace stripped)
2. SpellFixer.fix — direct typo dictionary + Levenshtein vs DEFAULT_KEYWORDS (threshold 0.75)
3. StructuralEnhancer.enhance — inject SCOPE, INTENT, CONSTRAINTS, OUTPUT markers if missing
output_marker_v1: OUTPUT: structured response ending with DONE. Before DONE, emit a <forward>...</forward> block containing 3-5 bullets naming the next likely steps (file paths, actions, decisions) so the next inference node can consume them as context.
guarantees: Deterministic — no randomness; same text + same dictionaries → same output
Lossless — original text preserved alongside enhanced in the return dict
Idempotent — re-enhancing an already-enhanced prompt is a no-op (markers detected, not duplicated)
Forward-chain-aware — OUTPUT marker now nudges controlled models to emit <forward> tail; forward_projector.extract_inline consumes that tail downstream
v1_extension_2026_05_28: OUTPUT marker extended to instruct emission of <forward>...</forward> bullets for the forward_projector inline path.
usage_example:
from prompt_enhancer import PromptEnhancer
result = PromptEnhancer().enhance('infrance the modle on the gpu', scope_hint='/home/tom/Projects/MySpace++')
print(result['replacements'])  # [('infrance','inference'), ('modle','model')]
print(result['added_markers'])  # ['SCOPE','INTENT','CONSTRAINTS','OUTPUT']
